why: Both make the right call to raise the price and honor existing bookings. Advice 1 is clearer and easier to act on, with a set 4-week review and an 83% break-even revert trigger. Advice 2 has good points, like the waitlist absorbing lost bookings, but it hedges its recommendation, assumes a ¥10,000 cost per shoot that wasn't given, and its revert rule is vaguer.
